name: Real-time power schedule, cut and variance corrections
description: Real-time shift traders spend part of each day correcting schedules and positions. When Colstrip or a counterparty cuts, they zero deals and book offsetting annuities. They fix import IDs and load zones, create DA and HA finals in CAPS, and run the SAR and INC reconciliation against CAPS and Enpower. They also repair El Paso Electric schedules with missing tags, check out schedules with counterparties by phone, and call generators every hour for checkout. The same cut is recorded in several places, including paper cut sheets and a Lotus Notes database, and procedures are re-issued when entries are inconsistent.
stall_points: Variances are found after the fact and need detective work. Real-time cuts are not in CAPS, so the SAR and INC only match after manual additions. HA finals creation hits SQL errors and data scrape failures that go unnoticed over weekends. The EPE schedule sheet misses tags day after day. Paper cut sheets get lost, and hourly generator calls are sometimes missed.
automation: A cut-entry form that zeroes the deal, books the offsetting annuity and logs the cut once to every destination. An automated morning SAR, INC and CARP comparison would write the reconciliation sheet. Tags in the EPE schedule would be validated automatically against dispatcher schedules, and the scrape and finals imports would be monitored with alerts. Metered generator output would be pulled into the services sheet automatically.
